reason: The cited evidence does not address AlCrFeNiSi alloy, Y2O3 dispersion in this alloy, or the specific nucleation and stress-reduction mechanisms proposed. E1 uses a different alloy system (AlCoCrFeNi on H13 steel) and E2 describes a method for NiCoCr, providing no direct support for the key premises.
premises: Nanoscale Y2O3 particles can be homogeneously dispersed into AlCrFeNiSi powder feedstock.
Y2O3 nanoparticles act as heterogeneous nucleation sites during LPBF, promoting equiaxed grains.
Grain refinement via Y2O3 reduces residual thermal stresses in LPBF-processed components.
Reduced thermal stresses and finer microstructure improve mechanical properties (strength and ductility).
The proposed mechanism is applicable to AlCrFeNiSi high-entropy alloy under LPBF conditions.
